title: OpenClassGen: A Large-Scale Corpus of Real-World Python Classes for LLM Research
abstract: arXiv:2504.15564v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing class-level code generation datasets are either synthetic (ClassEval: 100 classes) or insufficient in scale for modern training needs (RealClassEval: 400 classes), hindering robust evaluation and empirical analysis. We present OpenClassGen, a large-scale corpus of 324,843 Python classes extracted from 2,970 engineered open-source projects. Each entry pairs a human-written class with its corresponding skeleton, which comprises class and method signatures with associated docstrings, and is enriched with 27 static code metrics covering complexity, coupling, cohesion, and inheritance properties. Unlike prior benchmarks that require repository-level context resolution, OpenClassGen provides self-contained class skeletons that serve as complete generation specifications. We demonstrate the corpus's utility by evaluating three LLMs (GPT-o4-mini, Claude-4-Sonnet, Qwen-3-Coder) on a curated, executable subset of 300 classes, en

translated_title: OpenClassGen：面向大语言模型研究的大规模真实世界Python类语料库
translated_abstract: 现有的类级别代码生成数据集要么是合成的（ClassEval：100个类），要么规模不足以满足现代训练需求（RealClassEval：400个类），这阻碍了稳健的评估和实证分析。我们提出了OpenClassGen，这是一个从2,970个工程化开源项目中提取的大规模语料库，包含324,843个Python类。每个条目将一个人工编写的类与其对应的骨架配对，骨架包含类和方法签名及相关的文档字符串，并附带27个涵盖复杂性、耦合度、内聚性和继承属性的静态代码指标。与先前需要仓库级上下文解析的基准不同，OpenClassGen提供自包含的类骨架，可作为完整的生成规范。我们通过在一个精选的、可执行的300个类子集上评估三个大语言模型（GPT-o4-mini、Claude-4-Sonnet、Qwen-3-Coder），展示了该语料库的实用性……
tldr: OpenClassGen是一个从约3,000个开源项目中提取的包含32万余个真实Python类的大规模语料库，每个类均配有自包含的骨架和27项静态代码指标，为类级别代码生成的训练与评估提供了迄今最大规模的资源。
en_tdlr: OpenClassGen is a large-scale corpus of over 320,000 real-world Python classes from ~3,000 open-source projects, each paired with a self-contained skeleton and 27 static code metrics, providing the largest resource to date for training and evaluating class-level code generation.
